patch_description: Prepend a global RX layer with a shared parameter across all 8 qubits at the beginning of the ansatz. This introduces multi-axis rotation diversity to the initial state preparation, enabling the circuit to explore a richer parameterized state manifold. The cost is minimal (1 additional parameter: rx_shared), and this X-Y-Z sandwich pattern is known to improve expressibility and convergence in quantum machine learning. This should help reduce convergence steps from 150 back toward 90 while maintaining 100% accuracy with excellent parameter economy.
